caption: The drawing depicts a rectangular metallic lock mechanism lying flat against a plain, light beige background. The lock is predominantly brown with rust-colored areas and darker edges, displaying a worn, aged appearance with visible scratches and discoloration. Attached to the lock mechanism are two large, metal keys; both are grayish-silver in color, with circular bows and long, flat blades featuring distinct key bit shapes. One key is inserted upright into the lock while the other leans diagonally across it, intersecting the upright key. The two keys are connected by a small piece of thin, frayed string. The background is minimal and unadorned, highlighting the lock and keys as the sole objects in the composition. There is a faint handwritten signature and date located near the bottom right corner of the drawing.
title: Bar Lock and Keys
